items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 09 May 2026 at 11:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong wind.


##Synopsis##

Slow-moving low over the Norwegian Sea. High to the far west of Ireland, with a ridge to Hebrides.


##Wind##

Mainly northerly 4 or 5, but 5 or 6 in the west of the area, veering northeast this afternoon, then decreasing mostly 3 or 4 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly northeast 3 or 4, soon backing northwest, increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
